claim: Consumer press frames Kitchen Witch as a cozy fall aesthetic (labeled herb jars, drying flowers, candles, old-world decor), with the Practical Magic house as its 'nostalgic epitome'.
excerpt: Search summary: Kitchen Witch is about witchy crafts, dried herbs and old-world decor - labeling herb jars to display on a shelf, hanging flowers to dry, making paper, canning, beeswax candles; cites 'midnight margaritas' +140% on Pinterest. Restates Pinterest's data; it is not an independent measurement.
title: Pinterest Says It's a 'Kitchen Witch' Fall - Try These Hobbies to Make the Season Feel More Magical
